refs.note: GOV §12955 establishes the substantive violation; §§12989.1/12989.2 are the procedural + remedial mechanism; no §12989.2 remedy without a §12955 (or §12981) violation
Federal FHA (42 USC §3613) provides parallel civil action with actual/punitive damages + fees; §12989.2 and §3613 remedies are additive where both claims exist

GOV §12955(d): §12955 violations also trigger Unruh Act via §51(f); §12989.2 actual/punitive damages + §52 $4,000/offense statutory damages are additive — different remedial bases for the same underlying discriminatory act
If housing discrimination was also elder financial abuse, WIC §15657 provides treble damages + attorney fees; §12989.2 and WIC §15657 remedies are additive — each premised on different violations
